# Home: Equestria mods by modChad

Mods for [Home: Equestria](https://github.com/homedevanon/home-equestria), made for game version **0.3.0-maredev**.

Each mod is one `.pck` file. Download it from the table below (or all of them from the [latest release](https://github.com/modChad/home-equestria-mods/releases/latest)). Players only need the `.pck` (they're all in [release_packs](release_packs/)); the rest of each folder is its source.

## Installing

1. Download the `.pck` files you want from the table above. Keep only one version of each mod in the folder.
2. Put them in the game's mods folder. **Settings → Mods → Open mods folder** opens it for you.

   | System | Mods folder |
   | --- | --- |
   | Windows | `%APPDATA%\home-equestria-public\mods\` |
   | Linux | `~/.local/share/home-equestria-public/mods/` |
   | Quest | `Android/data/org.homeequestria.game/files/mods/` (USB file transfer; create the `mods` folder if it is missing) |

3. Restart the game. Each mod can be switched on and off in **Settings → Mods**.

**Mods are programs**: they run with the same rights as the game. Only install mods from people you trust.

## Building from source

Clone this repo as the `mods/` folder of the game's source project (with the game's source data for the same version), then run `./build_packs.sh` to build every mod into `release_packs/` as `<name>-v<version>.pck` (the name is the mod's folder with `_` as `-`, the version comes from its `mod.json`), or `./build_packs.sh <id>` for one. Any older `.pck` left in a mod's folder is set aside while it builds, so it isn't packed into the new one.

To build by hand instead, make sure there's no `.pck` in the mod's folder, then run:

```
godot --headless --xr-mode off --path <project> --script res://tools/modding/build_mod.gd -- <id> --out <file.pck>
```

The game lists every folder in `mods/` as a possible mod, so `release_packs/` shows up as "not loaded" in its log unless your copy of the game skips it.

See the game's own `mods/README.md` for the mod format.
